items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Don’t know him that well, but love his voice and love his interpretation.

ctx.x: I’m crazy about him. There was something else we had in common, because when he sings When Joanna Loved Me, it just – I love it so much. I love that song. Don’t know him that well, but love his voice and love his interpretation.
You guys did a doubleheader some years ago. I think it was in Tahoe.
